answer: Each agent first locks a non‑transferable quartz token earned by completing work on a secure enclave, binding the token to its cryptographic ID. Vouchers may endorse another agent only if both reside on the same trusted ledge within an island of the network, and any voucher whose vouchee is later exposed loses half of its token stake. To launch a Sybil attack the adversary must obtain separate quartz tokens and compromise a distinct ledge for every fake identity, making the cost grow linearly with the number of identities.
